name: dsh-theme-aurora
description: Aurora — a flat glass skin with a personalized overlay panel and a DeepSeek-chan pet, packaged as an installable DSH plugin bundle.

compatibility.note: Styled through --dsw-* tokens plus semantic hooks ([data-composer-card], [data-conversation-content], [data-sidebar-right-panel][data-sidebar-right-open], role=treeitem[aria-selected]); no CSS-module class names are referenced.
